title: Evaluating and Mitigating Bias in AI-Based Medical Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing text generation quality metrics (ROUGE scores, CheXpert scores) and calculating the Metric-Aware Fairness Difference (MFD) between male and female patient records in medical report generation and summarization.
Evaluating performance disparities using ROUGE scores, CheXpert pathology accuracy metrics, and MFD between Black and White patient subgroups.

Measuring discrepancies in generated text quality (via ROUGE, CheXpert, and MFD) across different patient age brackets, such as under 65 vs. 65 and older, as well as granular categories like adolescent, young adult, middle-aged, and aged.
Comparing text summarization performance (ROUGE scores) between biomedical papers focusing on humans versus those focusing on animals.

Calculating Metric-Aware Fairness Difference (MFD) and assessing generation metrics across compounded demographic subgroups, such as specific combinations of sex and race (e.g., Black females) or sex and age.
